definitions.gloss: secret photography; candid shot taken without permission
definitions.explanation: Taking photos or video of someone without their knowledge, or a photo taken that way.

examples.japanese: {隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}った→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: A secretly taken photo appeared in a magazine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芸能人|げいのうじん}→芸能人：14959_geinoujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Secret photos of celebrities easily cause trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: It came out that the employee had secretly filmed the meeting on a smartphone, and they were given a warning.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to photograph or film secretly
- {隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be photographed without knowing it
- {隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: a secretly taken photo

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盗撮|とうさつ}→盗撮：20492_tousatsu⟧: covert filming done wrongfully, typically voyeuristic and usually a crime; {隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り is broader and can be harmless, such as a candid shot of a sleeping friend.
